# Tally Court

> Scorekeeper for racket and rally sports on Apple Watch and iPhone: tennis, padel, pickleball, badminton, squash, table tennis and beach volleyball.

## Features

- Two big tap zones, a clear score, a serve indicator and full match history
- Tennis and padel: sets, tiebreaks, no-ad
- Badminton, pickleball, squash, table tennis, beach volleyball: points, win-by, cap
- Watch-first, with an iPhone companion that uses the same scoring engine
- Settings and match history sync between iPhone and Apple Watch
- Optional workout with live heart rate via Apple Health
- No account, no ads, no tracking, no data collected

## Requirements

- iPhone with iOS 17 or later and/or Apple Watch with watchOS 10 or later
